title: Control mapping: ISO 27001, NIST CSF and SOC 2

videos.script: In one month, three documents arrived at the clinic. {{three}} A health insurer sent a questionnaire, numbered by ISO 27001. The owners asked for one page, in the shape of the NIST framework. And the payment gateway sent its SOC 2 report. {{asks}} None of them asks about threats. They ask about controls, in their own words. {{words}} The good news is that the work is already done. Eleven controls, each tied to a threat and a cost. {{done}} Today you translate them. One small table, from each control to the numbers each framework uses. {{table}} Then a program reads it back, framework by framework. And the gaps it shows are not the ones you expect. {{gaps}}
